brief.use: in-match background loop under the play and the crowd; supports pace and tension, never the lead
brief.game: Fuzeball: 3D table football for an intergalactic Federation; blue + Federation gold
brief.references: pizzicato pulse, cello pedal, violin motif, tremolo tension, full-string climax, long hall and dotted-delay tails
brief.notes: G major is the relative major of the E minor menu tracks: it shares every note, so menu to match needs no key change. E minor and C# (lydian) colour the tension. 6/8, dotted-quarter pulse at 69, 80 bars (about 2 min 21 s), loop = whole file. Humanized quantize: 70% grid to 16ths, +-6 ms, +-5 velocity, seeded. Target -18 LUFS.
